channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: ‘On level of atomic bomb’: Iran highlights Hormuz importance amid US talks
item.description: The strait represents 'a capability that can affect the entire global economy with a single decision', politician says.

item.title: Bahrain rounds up dozens over alleged links to Iran’s IRGC
item.description: Interior Ministry says legal proceedings are under way against the 41 people arrested.

item.title: Iran says it will play at 2026 World Cup if hosts address ‘concerns’
item.description: Iran's presence at the tournament has been shrouded in uncertainty since the US and Israel launched war on the country.

item.title: The war on Iran will likely end in American retreat
item.description: The American empire cannot win the war against Iran at acceptable financial, military, and political costs.

item.title: Iran accuses US of 'reckless military adventure'
item.description: Abbas Araghchi says the US attacks each time there is a diplomatic solution on the table.

item.title: UK warship HMS Dragon heads to Middle East for potential Strait of Hormuz mission
item.description: The Ministry of Defence says the ship will prepare to join an international mission to safeguard shipping, but only when fighting in the region ends.

item.title: Person killed after being hit by plane on runway at Denver airport
item.description: The unidentified individual had jumped a perimeter fence two minutes before being struck by the airliner.

item.title: Oil prices rise after US and Iran exchange fire in Hormuz strait
item.description: US President Donald Trump says the ceasefire between Washington and Tehran is still in place.

item.title: The companies making billions from the Iran war
item.description: Through surging profits or soaring share prices, the war has been a boon for some firms.

item.title: Marco Rubio meets Pope Leo amid tensions with Trump over Iran war
item.description: Leo, the first American pontiff, drew Trump's ire after becoming a firm critic of the war and the administration's hardline immigration policies.
